title: When the word jazz and Dixieland came into use
summary: Dawson and Manetta recall that bands around Basin Street were called Dixieland, with uptown ragtime bands before.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Well, speaking of that term Dixieland, I never did ask fast either. When the word jazz began being used here in New Orleans, can you remember?
That was used right around Basin Street when we was playing. We started around by Harry Parker. And yes, Harry Parker, that's when we started that Dixieland.
I mean, that word, they called the jazz band. Was that the first time you ever heard of it? Oh, yes.
That's the way it started from, right around Basin in Ivorville. All around that, well, it was the district at that time. All around, through and there, you see.
Can you remember the first time you heard that word fast when they called anything a jazz band rather than a ragtime band or whatever they called it?

No, I remember it was very round, round the district like you said. That's a lot. Mm-hmm. And Dixieland came. Dixieland came on. Well, the district was born. The band was uptown. Field, a lot of bands up in the field.
And then they called that Dixieland.
Have they used that word jazz any place else before? Do you know? No. Or how they come to call it a jazz band, have you any idea? They called it Dixieland.

Yeah, they just would, you know, different bands would name what they want to their band. Say like Joe Oliver had a band, you'd say Joe Oliver's Dixieland band or some other band would say Joe Galloway. Galloway's Ragtime band and all that.

Well, that used to be the old bands. Mm-hmm. The old bands out in the field, uptown. Yeah. The Ragtime. Ragtime band. I called that Ragtime band, like Buddy Bowling. Yeah, like Buddy Bowling. Olivier, Charlie Galloway.

The Olivia band, I called it Olivier. Well, they had several other bands. Johnny Brown, here. Yeah, that's right. Well, that was Ragtime band. They called it Frank's band Ragtime band. Yeah. They joined in from Ragtime, to the Dixieland. Yeah.
